name: image_krea2_raw
description: Krea 2 RAW — the base, undistilled Krea 2 checkpoint (12B dense DiT). No distillation and no post-training, so it produces diverse, malleable outputs and is the checkpoint Krea recommends for fine-tuning, post-training research, and LoRA training. RAW is NOT tuned for final-quality generation on its own — for everyday images use image_krea2_turbo; reach for RAW when you want maximum output variation or a malleable base. Runs the qwen3vl_4b text encoder (CLIP type 'krea2') + qwen_image_vae. Full-step sampling: 52 er_sde steps at cfg 3.5, scheduler simple. Ships as bf16 — heavy: ~24 GB VRAM. Requires ComfyUI 0.26.0+.

prompt.description: Natural-language text prompt describing the image to generate. Krea 2 was trained on short, medium, and long prompts; detailed, longer prompts produce the best quality. No structured JSON or special syntax required.
